name: mojulo-work
description: Run Mojulo locally inside ChatGPT Work to build, edit and export deterministic 3D artifacts using the Work environment's compute.

interface.longDescription: Build, edit and export deterministic 3D objects, scenes, worlds and games by running Mojulo locally inside ChatGPT Work. The skill bootstraps the pinned Mojulo package into the active Work workspace and keeps Mojulo recipes, refs, checkpoints and exports with that workspace. This Work-native edition does not require hosted Mojulo execution.
defaultPrompt: Build a procedural city with Mojulo
Edit my Mojulo model and export a GLB
